check: if jq -e .scripts.typecheck package.json >/dev/null; then bun run typecheck; else bunx tsc --noEmit --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess; fi
bunx fallow dead-code || { echo 'Unused code: delete it, or import it from an entry point if it is meant to be used.'; exit 1; }
bunx fallow dupes --threshold 0.01 || { echo 'Duplicated code: extract it into one shared function and reuse it.'; exit 1; }
